senses.gloss: शण- + तान्तव शण- + तान्तव, adj., f. वी, woven of hemp, Man. 2, 42.

एक-, द्वि-, त्रि-, चतुर्-, पञ्चन्-, षष्-, सप्तन्-, अष्टन्- + नवतितम एक-, द्वि-, त्रि-, चतुर्-, पञ्चन्-, षष्-, सप्तन्-, अष्टन्- + नवतितम, ninetyfirst, second, third, fourth, etc., Rām. 2, adhy. 91 sqq.
शाण्डिली- + मातृ शाण्डिली- + मातृ, f. a matron descended from Śaṇḍila, Pañc. 122, 1.
षण्मासिक षण्मासिक, i. e. षष्-, adj. happening every sixth month, Pañc. 252, 14.

षाण्मासिक षाण्मासिक, i. e. षष्-मास + इक, adj.
 1. Relating to six months, come to pass six months ago, Bṛhaspati ap. Cowell, Kusumāñjali transl. p. 65, n. †.
 2. Half-yearly, Man. 7, 126.
षण्मुख षण्म्˚, i. e. षष्-, m. a proper name, Rājat. 6, 319 (Calc.).

† शण् शण्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To give (cf. श्रण्).
 2. To move(?).

शण शण, n.
 1. Hemp, MBh. 3, 16350.
 2. Bengal San, a plant from which a kind of hemp is prepared, Crotalaria juncea.
 3. (for *शर्ण, i. e. शॄ + न), An arrow.
 --Cf. κάνναϐις; O.H.G. hanaf; A.S. haenep (borrowed).

शाण शाण,
 A. i. e. शण + अ,
 I. adj. Made of Bengal San, Man. 2, 41.
 II. f. णी.
 1. Ragged garment.
 2. A new unseamed and single breadth of cloth, given to the religious student at his investiture.
 III. n. Coarse cloth, canvass.
 B. (from vb. शो, cf. शान), m., and f. णी.
 1. A whet or grindstone, Bhartṛ. 2, 36 (read शाणो˚).
 2. A touchstone.
शणसूत्रमय शण-सूत्र + मय, adj., f. यी, Consisting of शण-threads, Man. 2, 44.
शण्ठ शण्ठ, m. An eunuch (cf. शण्ड).

† शण्ड् शण्ड्, i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To disease.
 2. To collect.

शण्ड शण्ड,
 I. m. n. A collection of lotus flowers.
 II. m.
 1. An eunuch. []
 2. An impotent man.
 3. A bull at liberty (cf. शण्ठ and शण्ढ).

षण्ड षण्ड,
 I. m.
 1. A bull at liberty.
 2. An eunuch.
 3. A wood, a thicket, Megh. 20.
 4. A multitude.
 II. m. and n. A quantity of lotuses.
 --Comp.

शण्ढ शण्ढ, m.
 1. An eunuch.
 2. An attendant on the women's apartments.
 3. A bull at liberty (cf. the last, षण्ड, and षण्ढ).
षण्ढ षण्ढ, m. An eunuch, Man. 2, 158 (cf. the last).
शाण्डिल्य शाण्डिल्य, i. e. शण्डिल, a proper name, + य, patronym., f. ली (Pañc. 122, 1), Descended from Śaṇḍila, Pañc. ii. d. 83. m. The name of a Muni, Vedāntas. in Chr. 202, 18.
षण्डक षण्ड + क, m. An eunuch. MBh. 4, 52.
